fields.name: client_key
fields.help: Kaufland Marketplace Client Key (32 characters, seller portal API settings), sent as the Shop-Client-Key header.

fields.name: secret_key
fields.help: The Secret Key (64 characters): signs every request (hex HMAC-SHA256 over METHOD, full URI, body and Unix timestamp joined by newlines, sent as Shop-Signature with Shop-Timestamp). Never sent on the wire.

config_fields.name: storefront
config_fields.help: Kaufland storefront your offers live on: de, cz, sk, pl, at, fr, it, es or nl (GET /v2/info/storefront lists yours); sent as ?storefront= on unit and order-unit calls.

adapter.terms: Kaufland Global Marketplace Seller API v2: keys are self-issued in Seller Portal > Settings > API; every request is HMAC-signed (Shop-Client-Key, Shop-Timestamp, Shop-Signature). Offers are 'units' (id_unit); shipping and status are per order unit (id_order_unit).

me.note: GET /v2/info/storefront: the storefronts created for the signed-in seller ({data: ["de", ...]}).

set_inventory.note: PATCH /v2/units/{id_unit}?storefront {amount} sets the available amount of one offer unit; `listing_id` is the id_unit (required; units are not addressed by SKU). Returns the updated unit; `status` is the unit status (AVAILABLE|ONHOLD|INCOMPLETE).

end_listing.note: DELETE /v2/units/{id_unit}?storefront DELETES the offer unit (not reversible: a new unit must be created with POST /units). To pause an offer instead, set its amount to 0 with set_inventory.

list_orders.note: GET /v2/order-units: one row per ORDER UNIT (Kaufland ships, cancels and refunds per unit), so `id` is id_order_unit — the id mark_shipped needs — and the customer order is raw.id_order. status: open|need_to_be_sent|sent|received|cancelled|returned|returned_paid|sent_and_autopaid; since = ts_created_from_iso (YYYY-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ); limit max 100. Prices are integral cents (raw.price, raw.revenue_gross), so no decimal `total` is mapped.

mark_shipped.note: PATCH /v2/order-units/{id_order_unit}/send {tracking_numbers, carrier_code} marks ONE order unit as sent (answers 204). `order_id` must be the id_order_unit from list_orders (call once per unit of a multi-unit order); `carrier` is a Kaufland carrier code (e.g. DHL, DPD, GLS, Hermes, UPS — see ?page=order-files#carrier-codes). Both carrier and tracking_number are required by the endpoint.

not_offered.create_listing: POST /v2/units adds an offer to an EXISTING Kaufland product and requires ean or id_product, id_offer, handling_time and listing_price in integral cents; new product data goes through /product-data; the vocabulary has no EAN/product id or handling time.
not_offered.update_listing: PATCH /v2/units/{id_unit} takes listing_price 'in integral cents of the storefront's currency' — the vocabulary's decimal price cannot be converted without arithmetic — and titles/descriptions are product data, not unit fields; stock changes are set_inventory.

evidence: host sellerapi.kaufland.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
